notes.title: Best Day Ever is 20% off!
notes.content:
During 1 week, [u][b]Best Day Ever is on sale (20% off)[/b][/u]!
Take the opportunity to discover what's going on in Waters City!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286380/Best_Day_Ever/

[h2]Some reviews from the press[/h2]

[b]7.5 / 10[/b] - [url=https://www.actugaming.net/test-best-day-ever-415758/]ActuGaming[/url]
[quote]Cleverly mixing narrative choices and management mechanics while dealing with important issues of our society today, [i][Best Day Ever][/i] delivers interesting stories to follow, engaging characters and good replayability for the genre. A little indie gem to discover without delay.[/quote]
[b]Yes[/b] - [url=https://thepixelpost.com/passe-au-crible/critiques/best-day-ever-critique]The Pixel Post[/url]
[quote]Whether it's about homophobia, bullying, sexism, politics and a few other issues, the game always hits the mark. Its format, focused on one character each time, also allows you to enjoy short game sessions if you wish. It makes you want more of them to appear![/quote]
[b]8 / 10[/b] - [url=https://welcometolastweek.de/2021/07/05/best-day-ever-review-willkommen-im-leben/]Welcome To Last Week[/url]
[quote]The best day differs for everyone. But everyone should have the same prerequisites to reach it. ReRolled Studio reminds you of this in a very charming, positive way. Even small details can make a big difference. Even when things get tough.[/quote]
[b]JOUR DE GLOIRE / 10[/b] - [url=https://nintendoomed.it/best-day-ever-recensione/]Nintendoomed[/url]
[quote]An enjoyable and fun management game, which deals with serious themes without being too hardcore and mixes humor and serious moments well.[/quote]
[b]I Like it[/b] - [url=https://ladiesgamers.com/best-day-ever-review/]LadiesGamers[/url]
[quote]For what it is, Best Day Ever couldn’t be a better put together game. So if you can’t get enough of relationship simulations, visual novels, and games where choice matters, this game is certainly for you.[/quote]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1286380/extras/Gif_ville_bde.gif?t=1623413531[/img]

[h2]So what are you waiting for? Come and visit Waters City![/h2]

Want to learn more about Best Day Ever? Let's go [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286380/announcements/detail/3060739132485707965]there[/url]!

Have a great week!

notes.title: Best Day Ever is available on Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve got some great news to share!
We’re happy to announce that Best Day Ever is [u][b]available on Nintendo Switch today[/b][/u]!

[h2]How much?[/h2]
Best Day Ever costs $14.99 but has a [b]special launch discount at -10%[/b]. It only lasts one week, so be sure to take advantage of it before it's gone!

[h2]Is there any difference between the Steam and Switch versions?[/h2]
The two versions are basically [b]the same full experience[/b]. With the Nintendo Switch version, you can enjoy Best Day Ever [b]on TV or in portable mode[/b]. For this one, [b]classic controls[/b] are available as well as [b]touch controls[/b], which is pretty cool to use!

notes.title: Best Day Ever is available!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to Waters City![/h2]
The life here is pleasant. The people are kind, tolerant and... What? You don't believe it?
It's true that everything is not so easy for [b]Jenny[/b], [b]Paul[/b], [b]Emma[/b] and [b]Jordan[/b]. But it should be okay, because you'll be there to help them through their problems, right?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1286380/extras/Gif_ville_bde.gif[/img]

[h2]What is Best Day Ever, exactly?[/h2]
Best Day Ever is a narrative / management game in which you play [b]4 characters[/b]. To fulfill their objectives, you will have to [b]manage their daily life[/b] by choosing which actions to do throughout the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259609/b0d42a0a99afa83174d4b4c17771de9ab4814210.gif[/img]

During their activities, our characters will meet friends, strangers, and even less friendly people. During these dialogues and events, you will have to make [b]certain choices[/b], sometimes unimportant, other times crucial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259609/b653aef873a4d8f9e9e543466d75bd8be1fbed2a.gif[/img]

The choices you make with one character might have a [b]decisive impact[/b] in the story of the other 3 protagonists.

Can you create the best day ever for Jenny, Paul, Emma and Jordan?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1286380/extras/banni%C3%A8re_steam_txt.png[/img]

[h2]What are the themes of the Best Day Ever's stories?[/h2]
4 characters, 4 stories, 4 lives to discover spread over more than 5 months (fictional months, we reassure you!).
Each scenario deals with different themes. Consider Emma Nadjeur, for example: her boss, a well-known and talented businessman, tends to use insulting names to call her and mock her in front of her colleagues and clients.
Faced with this sexism, which affects her daily life, Emma is lucky to be able to count on her friend Kate, but also her colleague Iris, who is also affected by the same remarks. How to create a healthy atmosphere and change these bad behaviors in the company?

Despite appearances and serious themes, Best Day Ever's stories are meant to be positive and optimistic. You can always reach a "good ending"!

[h2]Any closing thoughts?[/h2]
The whole team hopes you enjoy Best Day Ever.
We are very proud to release this game and we are looking forward to reading your experiences and feedback!

Have a great day!
